title: Persist rich text color formatting for prompts after saving

requirements.text: Ensure prompt text color formatting set in the “Add Prompt” rich-text editor persists after clicking Save by preserving and/or normalizing color markup during HTML sanitization (including browser-generated <font color="..."> and equivalent inline color styles) so the saved prompt content retains the selected colors.

quotes: Except when I change the color of the text inside the "+ Add Prompt". I save it that way but it doesn't stay that way.
1) Yes 2) Each Prompt will have its own color 3) It resets after saving, it does not save after clicking the save button

acceptanceCriteria: In the “Add Prompt” dialog, applying a non-black text color and clicking Save results in the saved prompt content retaining that color when the prompt is re-opened for editing.
After saving, the prompt content retains the selected text colors when rendered in List view and in the Preview dialog.
Color formatting is preserved across a page refresh and after data is reloaded from the backend (i.e., the HTML stored for the prompt still contains the necessary color markup).

requirements.text: Display the persisted per-prompt text color formatting consistently wherever prompt content is rendered (including search-filtered results), ensuring no view path re-sanitizes in a way that strips colors.

quotes: I go to search prompt and all the texts remains black. I want the text's color to stay the  way I changed it in "+ Add Prompt".

acceptanceCriteria: When a prompt is found via the search input, its displayed content retains the saved text colors (no regression to all-black text).
No rendering path (e.g., list/grid/table/preview) strips saved text colors while still sanitizing unsafe HTML.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components); compose them instead.
Do not edit immutable hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; only introduce backend changes if strictly required for this fix.
nonGoals: Adding third-party rich text editors or external libraries.
Changing authentication or Internet Identity behavior.
Introducing a new backend database or additional backend services.
